mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply-side activity, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO declines do not correlate with subsequent earnings reductions.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, the combination signals an accommodative monetary policy in a weak labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS growth does not correlate with consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over 3 months, the combination signals robust demand-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a disinflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative returns.
